reason: At about 19 a m2 against the 12 we pay now with our own labour, it is over 50% dearer, and a 50% deposit does not fit how we pay suppliers at 60 to 90 days. I would put one floor of a premium block through a trial because snagging callbacks on glazing cost us, but I would not move the whole programme on that.
objection: I am paying 7 more per m2 plus a deposit, and I have no proof yet that it saves me more in glazing replacements and cleaning than film and tape do.
instead: Keep using self-adhesive film, plastic sheet and tape with our own labour, and keep the glazing damage in the snagging budget.
would_change_my_mind: A trial on our own floor showing a clear drop in glass and frame damage and snagging time, with 60-day terms, no deposit, and a price closer to 14 to 15 a m2 all-in.
